records.label: CIRCDIST.sat.instances claim
records.text: Determine or rigorously bound (d_infinity,R_stab) for a standard surface-code schedule, a legal hook-misaligned surface-code schedule, and at least one explicitly specified qLDPC schedule, using two independent methods where feasible, and for each instance provide auditable minimum witnesses and a justified attribution among single-round hook/bulk, temporal-boundary, measurement-fault, and mixed multi-round mechanisms.

records.label: finite-prefix-window-closure implication
records.text: The instances dossier's reviewed finite computations establish, within their stated computed windows, the d_R values for the standard rotated-surface d = 5 schedule, the legal doubly hook-misaligned rotated-surface d = 5 schedule, and the BB [[18,4,4]] schedule; its audited minimum witnesses and restricted exact optimizations establish the scoped mechanism attributions required by this claim. These finite-window values, witnesses, and attributions do not use CIRCDIST.sat.window. The two records use the same listed full temporal-boundary detector coordinates; on the selected BB prefix, the extra redundancy detectors identified by S3-prime were independently added through R = d and did not change d_R. Under their shared uniform unit-cost full-Pauli fault model, the dossier's faulty-location minima equal the window theorem's elementary-fault minima because same-location faults may be replaced by their Pauli product while preserving the effect and never increasing weight. The premise CIRCDIST.sat.window then gives d_R = d_d = d_infinity for every R >= d, so the computed first-d prefixes determine d_infinity and R_stab for those three schedules. Conditional on that premise and subject to the node's existing scope caveats, these results establish every clause of the CIRCDIST.sat.instances claim.

records.label: CIRCDIST.sat.window claim
records.text: For every CSS code Q = [[n,k,d]] with k >= 1 and every fixed legal (conflict-free and measurement-consistent) single-round single-ancilla CSS syndrome-extraction schedule M for Q, let C_R^Z(M) and C_R^X(M) be the ideal-boundary memory experiments formed by R verbatim repetitions of M with the uniform unit-cost full-Pauli per-location fault model, and let d_R(M) be the minimum of their circuit distances measured against, respectively, the canonical detector space of Definition 3.5 in the CIRCDIST.sat.transfer proof dossier and its section-8.1 mirror (equivalently in value only, not in detector-set equality, the corresponding Definition-2.7 detector sets). Then d_(R+1)(M) <= d_R(M) for every R >= 1; d_infinity(M) := lim_{R to infinity} d_R(M) exists; in each memory sector every minimum-weight undetectable logical has a same-weight sector-pure representative supported on a contiguous interval of rounds whose span is at most its faulty-location weight; and, writing d = min(d_X,d_Z) for the CSS code distance and R_stab(M) := min{R_0 >= 1 : d_R(M) = d_infinity(M) for all R >= R_0}, one has R_stab(M) <= d_infinity(M) <= d and d_R(M) = d_d(M) = d_infinity(M) for every R >= d. Consequently d_1(M),...,d_d(M) determine both d_infinity(M) and R_stab(M).

records.label: CIRCDIST.sat.transfer claim
records.text: For every CSS code Q = [[n,k,d]] with k >= 1, with H_X and H_Z the matrices of the given (possibly dependent) X- and Z-check generating rows, and every depth-T, T >= 1, conflict-free (no physical qubit participates in two CNOTs in one time step) and measurement-consistent single-round single-ancilla CNOT schedule M in which each X-check has one freshly |+>-prepared, X-measured control ancilla coupled exactly once to each support qubit and each Z-check has one freshly |0>-prepared, Z-measured target ancilla coupled exactly once from each support qubit, where measurement consistency means #{q in supp(a) intersect supp(b): t(q->b) < t(a->q)} = 0 mod 2 for every X-check a and Z-check b, define C_R^Z(M) and C_R^X(M), R >= 1, by R verbatim copies of M with disjoint copied location sets and no cross-round idle compression, ideal |0> and |+> data initialization respectively, and ideal transversal Z and X terminal readout respectively. At every copied CNOT location allow the full 15-element nonidentity two-qubit Pauli menu after the gate, at every copied idle and post-ancilla-preparation location allow the full three-element nonidentity one-qubit Pauli menu, and at every copied record location allow a flip; a configuration costs its number of occupied locations, while data initialization and terminal readout are fault-free. Against the canonical detector space D of Definition 3.5 of circdist/artifacts/circdist_sat_transfer_proof_20260823.md, namely the deterministic record parities whose value is constant across the prepared logical-basis input family, put Sigma^Z = F_2^n/row(H_X), and let w_M^Z([delta],mu) be the minimum occupied-location cost of a one-round X-sector configuration with residual data-X class [delta] and own Z-check-record flip vector mu. Over the min-plus semiring S = (Z_{>=0} union {+infinity}, min, +), define A^Z[sigma,sigma'] = w_M^Z(sigma'-sigma,H_Z sigma), u^Z[sigma] = 0 exactly when sigma = [0] and +infinity otherwise, and v^Z[sigma] = 0 exactly when H_Z sigma = 0 and sigma != [0] and +infinity otherwise. The dictionary is finite everywhere and explicitly constructible by finite enumeration, and for every R >= 1, d_R^Z(M) = u^Z min-plus (A^Z)^R min-plus v^Z. Every physical undetectable logical configuration projects to an R-edge path of cost at most its occupied-location weight, and every finite such path lifts to a physical undetectable logical configuration of exactly its cost. Swapping X and Z, H_X and H_Z, controls and targets gives the mirror system (u^X,A^X,v^X) on Sigma^X = F_2^n/row(H_Z) and the identical equality for d_R^X(M). On Sigma^Z disjoint-union Sigma^X, the block-diagonal A = A^Z direct-sum A^X with concatenated u and v satisfies d_R(M) = min(d_R^Z(M),d_R^X(M)) = u min-plus A^R min-plus v for every R >= 1. Every within-sector entry of A is finite; the cross-sector entries are +infinity, and the +infinity entries of u and v encode exactly the excluded initial and terminal states. In each sector the same minimum value is obtained (i) with collision-permitting multisets of unit elementary faults or with occupied faulty locations, by Lemma 2.9 and the full per-location Pauli-group and uniform-cost hypotheses, and (ii) against the Definition-2.7 detector set or D, by Proposition 3.7 in the Z-memory sector and its section-8.1 mirror in the X-memory sector. Clause (ii) is equality of minimum values for that ordered pair of detector conventions, not equality of their detector spaces and not invariance under arbitrary detector/observable splits. No claim about eventual periodicity or constancy of matrix powers, state-space minimality, or polynomial construction time is made.

records.label: CIRCDIST.sat root claim
records.text: For every CSS code Q = [[n,k,d]] with k >= 1 and every fixed legal (conflict-free and measurement-consistent) single-round single-ancilla CSS syndrome-extraction schedule M for Q, let C_R^Z(M) and C_R^X(M) be the memory experiments formed by R verbatim repetitions of M with ideal initialization, ideal terminal data readout, and the uniform unit-cost full-Pauli per-location fault model, and let d_R(M) be the minimum of their circuit distances measured against, respectively, the canonical detector space of Definition 3.5 in the CIRCDIST.sat.transfer proof dossier and its section-8.1 mirror. Proposition 3.7 and that mirror give the same distance value in each sector when the corresponding Definition-2.7 detector set is used; this says neither that the two detector sets are equal nor that the value is invariant under any other detector/observable split. Define d_infinity(M) = lim_{R to infinity} d_R(M) and R_stab(M) = min{R_0 >= 1 : d_R(M) = d_infinity(M) for all R >= R_0}. Give a finite-state min-plus representation of d_R, prove an explicit finite-window theorem and algorithm deciding (d_infinity,R_stab), compute or rigorously bound that pair for a standard surface-code schedule, a legal hook-misaligned surface-code schedule, and at least one qLDPC schedule, and attribute the distance-limiting mechanism using auditable minimum witnesses.
